counterexamples.shallow_copy: copy pointer word; pointee changes/dies before dispatch -> original argument not retained
counterexamples.ui_boundary: queue callback wrapper; change wrapper.manager; native invocation resolves new manager
counterexamples.terminal_reply_loss: recycle DONE slot before acknowledgement -> old result overwritten; final model retains until ACK
counterexamples.reentry: outer depth1 -> inner depth2 -> inner returns depth1: cannot release outer resources
counterexamples.stop_flag: request stop; current callback writes source after request
counterexamples.task_state: wakeup/timeout changes metadata but selected task not executed; CPU access authority remains
counterexamples.hardware: callback returns; peripheral may still own descriptor/buffer: callback return alone cannot free
counterexamples.sync_deferral: caller expects result/output before returning; WAIT value cannot substitute native ABI result
counterexamples.ordered_transition: transition command cannot overtake earlier accepted work without explicit stale-generation policy
counterexamples.deadlock: synchronous caller waits while holding DRAW; queued CRITICAL needs IDLE -> cycle

limits: Known scalar codec only; target registry and metadata serialization assumed
No native watchdog, cancellation, global CPU cessation or peripheral/DMA drain proven
No runtime command drop/reorder to hide native errors
